**Summary: User-identity management is now fully internalized, making the skill easier and safer to use.**

- User identity acquisition/handling moved entirely inside the scripts; users no longer need to supply or see any open-id or identity information.
- Inputs and outputs streamlined: skill now only requires media input (video/file/URL), and all identity linkage is automatic.
- Documentation updated: setup, workflow, usage examples, and constraints rewritten to reflect the new, transparent authentication approach.
- Removed all prompts asking users for identity/account info; API and report queries strictly use internal parameters.
- General documentation and script references improved for clarity and simplicity.

smyx-child-outdoor-activity-monitor-analysis v1.0.0

- Initial release of skill for monitoring child outdoor activity based on fixed camera footage at balcony or home entrance.
- Automatically detects child entries/exits, records timestamps, and accumulates total daily outdoor activity duration.
- Issues reminders if daily outdoor activity falls below recommended threshold (default: 1 hour/day).
- Generates automatic daily reports and pushes app reminders to parents if insufficient activity persists multiple days.
- Requires open-id authentication for saving and retrieving historical reports; enforces privacy and consent best practices.
- Can be integrated with smart cameras or family education apps as a practical child health management feature.
